_meta.purpose: Model tiers for the model suggestion (plan section 5.5). Lineups change, so this is config, not code.
_meta.warning: Model names below are examples of how to fill this in. Check each provider's current lineup before the demo, and check what their own model pickers do today (plan section 20) so nothing on screen is stale.
_meta.rule: The product never switches models. These tiers only drive a suggestion the user accepts or ignores.

tiers.label: Small
tiers.description: Short, well-defined work: classification, extraction, translation, reformatting, grammar fixes.

tiers.label: Medium
tiers.description: Everyday work: summaries, drafting, straightforward questions, light code.

tiers.label: Large
tiers.description: Hard reasoning, long multi-step work, architecture and debugging across many files, proofs.

default_assumed_tier_note: What we assume the user is on when they have not told us. Assuming large makes the suggestion look better, so the UI states this assumption out loud and lets the user change it.
